Wikipedia's Category Hierarchy

The topical structure the expertise measure is computed over. Administrative scaffolding (People biographies and all “by-country / by-year” partitions) is hidden so the real sub-fields show. Inner ring = top-level domains; each ring outward is one depth; wedge angle ∝ number of topical sub-categories. Click a wedge to zoom · hover to see a branch's words and their expertise →

Hover a branch

to inspect its words
Up to 15 words most concentrated in the branch, ranked by expertise. Some branches show fewer: a word qualifies only if it occurs ≥20× in that category, is in the expertise vocabulary (~11k words), and is not a stem-variant of a word already listed — so narrow or very deep branches run out of qualifying words first.
H₁ breadth · ∇ gradient (H₃−H₅) · rarity = 1−f (f = frequency) · xpt expertise = H₁ × ∇ × (1−f)
